fact: L'Economie reports taxpayers declare on the E-Tax platform, and the Fouta pilot was run among firms already familiar with online declaration.

L'Economie reports that since 3 August 2026 taxpayers pay taxes and levies online through the Fouta national switch after declaring on E-Tax, with an electronic Treasury receipt, rollout to all taxpayers by end of 2026.

The Ministry of Finance says the FOUTA online tax payment platform is being deployed in three phases, with a pilot phase engaged, large and medium enterprises next, and all taxpayers by the end of 2026.
The Ministry of Finance says the FOUTA pilot phase was engaged with a number of enterprises that already file returns electronically (telediclaration), with the declaration made on E-Tax.

The Ministry of Finance says taxes are paid online through FOUTA after declaration on E-Tax, by mobile money or bank transfer validated by OTP, with a signed electronic receipt, and a live payment demonstration was given on 3 July 2026 (pilot phase).
